findings.analytic_scope: Nine 2x2 center/edge/negative/integer-repeat/paired-row-orientation cases match independent expected values and the corrected candidate kernel; separate mid-gray filtering check passes.
findings.evidence: scripts/fur_root_sampling.py:41 computes mod(uv,1)*[W,H]-.5, wraps both neighboring indices, decodes each texel then interpolates.

findings.actual_panda_reason: Saved source JSON sampler is magFilter9729/minFilter9987 with REPEAT defaults; local Blender importer maps that to Linear/REPEAT.
findings.evidence: shared_color_texture validates REPEAT, FLAT and a direct image but never interpolation. The extracted production helper accepts Linear, Closest, Cubic and Smart in the analytic fixture. Tuft root colors are always bilinear LOD0.

texture_colors uses the first UV loop per vertex and repeat nearest texels. Mask/band selection and legacy/combed root colors depend on it; combed colors are barycentric interpolation of decoded vertex samples, not root-UV filtering.
findings.recommendation: Do not silently change this path while repairing exact-root contracts.

findings.evidence: RootColorSampler has no automatic row flip, material-factor handling or mip/derivative evaluation. Tuft adapter supplies Blender active loop UVs and bottom-up image rows; the candidate uses glTF image-V-down UVs and PIL top-down rows. Pairing is correct.
findings.recommendation: Record the paired coordinate convention and LOD0 limit; future strict exact-root admission should verify sampled UV layer is also the render-active layer.

limits: Tiny analytic arrays only; no render, source-texture scan, or throughput/memory claim.
Color probe conclusion remains limited to byte-sRGB PNG/JPEG samples and the pinned Blender version.
No production or tests were changed; implementation awaits root release.

official_lookup.result: Tool fetch failed HTTP402; no content relied upon. Local bundled official glTF importer/exporter code was inspected instead; unspecified native defaults remain labeled unprobed.

proposed_tests: 2x2 four distinct corner colors at exact texel centers (.25,.25),(.75,.25),(.25,.75),(.75,.75).
At UV0/1 corners expect periodic four-texel blend; at a row seam expect its two-texel blend.
Negative and integer-offset UVs repeat identically, with no endpoint-grid width-minus-one mapping.
Mid-gray and white mix must equal mean of decoded texels, not decoded mean; linear-input bypass unchanged.
Paired PIL/glTF top-down and Blender bottom-up/v-flipped arrays return identical physical colors; wrong orientation fails.
Strict adapter accepts homogeneous Linear/REPEAT/direct sampled-render UV; rejects Closest/Cubic/Smart and mismatched render-active UV before pixel allocation.
Legacy shared admission and default/combed color/geometry fixtures remain unchanged; existing exact sampler results remain identical.
Actual native or GPU filtering/mipmap equality is not asserted by these analytic tests.

smallest_recommended_change.exact_root_admission: Add a strict Linear/REPEAT/direct active-render-UV source check only for the exact-root path; reject unsupported filter modes rather than silently approximating them. Keep shared legacy admission unchanged through an optional strict flag or a separate helper.
smallest_recommended_change.experimental_migration: Do not edit sealed experimental sources. Any future reusable edge helper gets an explicit new policy opt-in and shared verified sampler math; keep the endpoint-grid legacy policy only for historical reproduction. No geometry/default quality promotion is implied.
smallest_recommended_change.interface_suggestion: Keep RootColorSampler(pixels,triangle_uvs,pixels_are_linear=False) unchanged. Add a strict source-node validation helper or keyword-only strict flag at the adapter boundary; pass the source texture node there, not only its image.
smallest_recommended_change.other_modes: No CLAMP/MIRROR/nearest/cubic/mip emulation is needed for this narrow fix; fail explicitly under the strict policy.
smallest_recommended_change.versioning: Record this policy and coordinate/LOD0 fields in exact-root reports. Existing supported Linear/REPEAT tuft numeric output stays byte-identical. Unchanged default/legacy/combed profiles keep historical behavior.

summary: Production RootColorSampler already has normalized texel-center REPEAT math. Preserve it and encoded byte-sRGB interpretation; tighten the exact-root source contract rather than applying a gamma fix.
